CheckTitle: Ensure to enable Audit on BI Publisher and OTBI Activity (Execution, Modification, and Usage Analytics)
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
Description: Audit BI Publisher and OTBI report execution, catalog changes and access-control changes, and centralise the data.
Risk: Reports can read and export large amounts of sensitive data without a trace.
AuditProcedure: BI Publisher Runtime Configuration: 'Enable SQL session trace' is True.
Tools > Audit Reports for Oracle Business Intelligence events; OTBI usage/performance subject areas enabled.
Data reaches a SIEM or central log store.

Steps: Enable the settings above and export BI/OTBI audit data to a central store.
